name: Sine Sub Roller
desc: FUSES dub techno's pillow sine sub (bass.dubtech.sine_sub) with dnb's rolling phrasing (bass.dnb.reese_dark's motion): a G-minor sub that breathes dub space but rolls the 170 grid, with an every-4 dub throw on the tail notes.

code.full: note("[g1 ~ g1 g1 ~ g1 ~ <bb1 f1 c2 d2>]").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.008).decay(.4).sustain(.35).release(.15).penv(.6).pdec(.09).shape(${drive}).lpf(700).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).every(4, x=>x.delay(.5).delaytime(.275).delayfeedback(.45)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("[g1 g1 ~ g1 g1 ~ g1 <bb1 f1 c2 d2>]").add(note(${root})).superimpose(x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.35)).s("sine").attack(.006).decay(.35).sustain(.35).release(.12).penv(.8).pdec(.08).shape(${drive}*1.25).lpf(900).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.72,${gain}).fast(4)).every(2, x=>x.delay(.45).delaytime(.275).delayfeedback(.5)).orbit(3).play()
